name: SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after round 5 once the last player has passed

categories.label: Score track (VP gained during play)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên bảng điểm (tích lũy trong ván)
categories.hint: Marker position at end of round 5, before final scoring. Past 100 = add 100 per lap.

categories.label: End-of-game scoring cards
categories.hint: Sum of points from played cards with a gold box.

categories.label: Gold scoring tile chosen at 25 VP
categories.labelVi: Thẻ vàng chọn ở mốc 25 điểm
categories.hint: Sets of the tile's condition x value of your marker on that tile.

categories.label: Gold scoring tile chosen at 50 VP
categories.labelVi: Thẻ vàng chọn ở mốc 50 điểm
categories.hint: Skip if you never reached 50 VP.

categories.label: Gold scoring tile chosen at 70 VP
categories.labelVi: Thẻ vàng chọn ở mốc 70 điểm
categories.hint: Skip if you never reached 70 VP.

categories.label: Alien species bonus scoring
categories.hint: Only if a discovered alien species adds an extra end-game scoring step.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: players with equal points share the tie.

notes: Gold tiles (3 of 4 in play): Tech (sets of 3 types / pairs of techs), Mission (completed missions / pairs of missions+end-game cards), Income (sets of 3 income types / most-tucked type), Other (sets of 3 life-trace colours / sector wins paired with orbiter or lander). Marker values on each tile depend on selection order (first picker gets highest). Each gold milestone can only pick a tile not already marked by that player. Solo: rival scores 5 per uncompleted objective instead of gold tiles. Expansion 'Space Agencies' not modelled. Which gold-tile side is in play is not recorded.

sources.title: SETI rulebook EN (CGE, 2024-09-17)
sources.section: p.18 Milestones (gold milestones at 25/50/70); p.21 End of Game (final scoring, gold scoring tiles); p.22 solo end of game
